name: Yajuu
source:
Farrow is a knight who has a one-sided love for close friend and fellow knight Redo, but one day, Redo disappears. A few years later they meet again, but, instead of a friendly reunion, these two have now become enemies.

[From The Yaoi Treasure Trove]
